description: Delete a problem category and every problem in it, as the Problems page does. The judge is no longer asked to check for it, but a new category may be opened if the fault keeps appearing; add_to_never_flag also writes a do-not-flag rule from the category, which stops that. Use it for a category that is wrong or no longer relevant; mark a fixed one solved instead (set_category_solved). Deleting cannot be undone. Before you call this, look the item up so you know it exists; if it does not, say so and ask nothing. Then tell the user plainly what will be deleted, naming it as the lookup shows it, and ask whether they are sure, in words like: "You asked me to delete <what>. Are you sure you want to proceed?" Then stop and wait. Call it only when the user's next message confirms that exact item. If several items could be meant, list them with their ids and ask which; the user's choice is not a confirmation, so name the chosen item with its id and ask again. If they decline, hesitate, ask something else or change the request, do not delete; ask again before deleting later.

add_to_never_flag.description: Also write a do-not-flag rule from the category, so the judge stops reporting it and it is not opened again.
add_to_never_flag.title: Add To Never Flag

category.description: The category's id or title, as list_problem_categories shows them.
